name: How long does a garage tile installation project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage tile installation project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard garage tile project typically takes four to seven days from concrete preparation to complete curing. The timeline begins with one or two days for concrete repairs, grinding, and crack treatment. Setting the porcelain tile takes another one to two days depending on the garage size and custom cuts. The floor must then cure for 24 hours before grouting. The biggest timing tradeoff is vehicle access: while you can walk on the floor within 48 hours of grouting, heavy vehicles should not park on the floor for at least seven full days to prevent disturbing the mortar bond.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes four to seven days, but you should wait at least seven days after grouting before parking vehicles on the new floor.
